articles.description: Josh Hokit may be giving up size against Ciryl Gane, but Chael Sonnen believes that could create a very interesting matchup. Gane is a physically impressive heavyweight, weighing close to 250 pounds, but he's not simply a big, slow heavyweight who can be bullied around. articles.description: Chael Sonnen is back at a location that brings back a memory he says he'll never forget. Standing in the lobby where an MMA fighter went down, Chael recalls being in Abu Dhabi in 2001 and learning about the country's strict laws surrounding physical altercations. According to Chael, even if someone throws the first punch and you're simply defending yourself, you could still face serious consequences. He remembers being told that the person who retaliates could receive six months in jail, while the person who started the altercation could face two years. It's a story that left a lasting impression on Chael—and a reminder that the rules can be very different when you're traveling internationally. #ChaelSonnen #MMA #AbuDhabi #UFC #MMAStories

articles.title: Merab and Usman ARRESTED! (Chael's Abu Dhabi Update)
articles.description: Chael Sonnen is in Abu Dhabi with a major update on the confrontation between Merab Dvalishvili and Usman Nurmagomedov. According to information Chael received on the ground, the initial video showed Usman approaching Merab before a fight broke out. But a second video, reportedly recorded five minutes earlier, showed Merab initiating physical contact with a Russian wrestler. Chael explains how the second video allegedly changed the situation, leading to both Merab and Usman being detained.
